s.how: Heat a buttered cast iron pan in a 200C oven. Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 60g melted butter. Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes. Serve warm with butter.

s.note: the bar the cadets accidentally wander into
s.how: Finely dice 1 shallot and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar and cracked pepper. Lay 16 freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice, spoon a little mignonette over each and serve with lemon wedges. Grill a few with garlic butter for anyone nervous about raw.

m.note: Tackleberry would eat it standing up
m.how: Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 60g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 1 grated onion and 1 tbsp Worcestershire. Press into a loaf tin, glaze with 80ml tomato sauce mixed with 1 tbsp brown sugar, bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Serve thick slices with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and milk.

w.note: the class of eighty-four makes it
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake in a slab tin at 175C for 30 minutes. Beat 200g butter with 350g icing sugar, spread on and pipe a badge and Graduates in blue.

d.note: the bar the cadets accidentally wander into
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Shake 160ml vodka, 80ml blue curaçao and 60ml fresh lemon juice with ice for 10 seconds. Strain evenly into the glasses. Top each with about 120ml cold lemonade and stir once. Garnish with a lemon wheel and a cocktail cherry.
